scope: Jev for QL and MEF lensing/classification, plus typed refereeing of the loop's decision points. The M-coordinate census work is deliberately out of scope (owner scoping 2026-09-17).
access: TypeSafe System One API — POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, Bearer TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Question primitives: noul (probability of yes), choice (one of a defined set + distribution), score (probability-weighted position on ordered levels). The Vercel AI Gateway path (typesafe-ai/jev via AI SDK experimental_evaluate) is an alternative route; this catalogue is written against the direct API, where the gateway's boolean maps to noul.
integration_law: From the vendored TypeSafe skill (jev/skill/typesafe-ai, rev 65a39f3): code owns the workflow — known rules, exact lookups, execution and thresholds stay in Rust; the model supplies programmable common sense. In this programme the pairing is: the LLM owns semantics (generation, reflection); Jev owns typed classification across QL positions and MEF lenses and referees the loop's decision points.

instrument_standing.law: answers are instrument readings, never the run determination; determination remains pending-human-review

ql-mef-lensing.purpose: typed classification across QL positions and MEF lenses

questions.instructions: Which position's responsibility does this act belong to in a QL-native agent recurrence? Positions are responsibilities, not chronological stages.
questions.truth_standing: loop-recorded position state from the retained ql-condition runs; not human-verified

questions.instructions: Through which MEF lens is this subject most coherently read? The lens is a reading taken now, never an identity assigned to the subject: subject identity is not lens identity.

criteria.L0': Archetypal-Numerical — one through six as archetypal number
criteria.L1': Phenomenal — introversion, sensation, feeling, thinking, intuition, extroversion
criteria.L2: Logical — tetralemmaic ground: IS, IS-NOT, BOTH, NEITHER, SILENCE
criteria.L4: Phenomenological — Sein, Geworfenheit, Dasein, Zeit, Besorge, Gelassenheit
criteria.L4': Scientific — prompts, traces, challenges, patterns, discovery, insight
criteria.L5: Para Vāk — anuttara/asambhava, para vāk, paśyantī, madhyamā, vaikharī, mātṛkā
criteria.L5': Divine Logos — arche, apokalypsis, dynamis and the logological articulation

questions.truth_standing: none — instrument reading, research standing; the retained runs carry the runtime's standing refraction pair L1+L4', so the harness reports Jev's mass on that pair as agreement-of-readings, not accuracy

questions.instructions: How coherently does the proposed lens reading refract this subject, judged only from the subject's declared content and the lens's own articulation?
criteria: incoherent: the reading contradicts the subject's declared content
loose: the reading shares vocabulary but not structure
coherent: the reading discloses structure the subject's content supports
strong: the reading discloses structure and names what the content leaves implicit

loop-refereeing.purpose: typed answers at the QL loop's model-facing decision points, replayed from retained run records

decision_context.allowance_state: record of per-position budgets and spends
decision_context.recent_transcript_digest: sha256 over the recent event window (events themselves may be included bounded)
decision_context.provenance: pointer into the retained run record (file + record index)

questions.instructions: Which carrier kind should the next exterior act use? internal_control is only a closure request.

criteria.model: the act is an act of judgement or language
criteria.capability: the act is an exterior effect on the workspace through a named capability
criteria.internal_control: the realisable intent is already achieved and no exterior act remains

questions.instructions: Is the realisable intent of the circuit already achieved relative to the success conditions? Answer yes only if the realised state satisfies them.

criteria: inadequate: the act does not serve the active position's responsibility
partial: it serves the position but leaves the evidence chain broken
adequate: it serves the position and is checkable against success conditions
excellent: it serves the position, is checkable, and closes distance without repetition

questions.instructions: Should the circuit close on this determination, or reopen?

criteria.close: the realised state satisfies the success conditions with verifiable evidence
criteria.reopen: a condition remains unrealisable or unverified

questions.instructions: How adequate is the realised state relative to the initiating intent?
Is the claimed completion subject exactly the task id and verifiable from measured state (not free text)?

Given the observed state, was this stipulation violated? The stipulation's own statement defines what counts as violation; exclusion stipulations forbid the entire class of action including creating new artifacts.

Is there a genuinely local whole — a sub-question whose independent resolution would materially change the evaluation and which is resolvable without the parent's transcript — warranting independent treatment at the lemniscate point?

Which position's responsibility should the recurrence move to? Positions are responsibilities, not chronological stages: P0 initiating intent and operative frame; P1 material, evidence and givens; P2 effect, operation and transformation; P3 form, pattern and implementation; P4 whole-relative evaluation, context and adequacy; P5 candidate determination and synthesis.

comparison_targets: the incumbent LLM's recorded decision (retained Series-1 run records)
human review when it lands (pending-human-review law unchanged)

concrescence.purpose: QL-native typed judgement: is the determination (#5) warranted given the frame (#0) and the maturity/balance of the middle types (#1-#4)? The concrescence question — 'given #0, given enough balance and maturity of #1-#4, #5 is/appears to be the case' — held across types, not position-guessing. Validated by a synthetic degradation ladder: gutted circuits must read as less satisfied, or the instrument is invalid before any agreement number counts.

questions.instructions: You are given a completed piece of work as a QL whole: the initiating intent (#0), the residues gathered at material/effect/form/evaluation (#1-#4), and a candidate determination (#5). Judge across the types: given #0, and given the balance and maturity of #1-#4 as stated, is #5 warranted — does the whole achieve satisfaction, so that #5 appears to be the case? Answer as probability of yes.
Given the initiating intent (#0) in the state, how mature and balanced are the middle residues (#1 material, #2 effect, #3 form, #4 evaluation) relative to what #0 demands? Score 0-3.
criteria: 0 - bare: middle types absent or empty relative to the intent
1 - thin: some material present but visibly unbalanced or immature
2 - adequate: the middle types carry the intent forward recognisably
3 - full: balanced and mature; the whole visibly supports determination

questions.instructions: Given the initiating intent (#0), the middle residues (#1-#4), and the candidate determination (#5) in the state: should this circuit close on this determination, or reopen because the whole is not yet satisfied? This is asked of the whole, not of the loop's bookkeeping.
